about: The secreta of the formulary “Epiphany of the Lord” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Look graciously, we beseech You, O Lord, upon the gifts of Your Church, in which gold, frankincense, and myrrh are no longer offered, but He whom those gifts declare is sacrificed and received: Jesus Christ, Your Son, our Lord, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,

a.g: who lives and reigns with You
